title: Text as an Index for Zero-Shot Cross-Domain Knowledge Tracing
abstract: arXiv:2610.41883v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge tracing (KT) predicts a student's next response from their history. New platforms often have question texts but no response logs for training, motivating zero-shot cross-domain KT. Existing transfer and cold-start methods use question semantics, but cross-platform semantic discrepancies limit transferability. We propose TIZSKT, which separates behavioral sequence modeling from domain-local historical evidence construction and uses text as an index rather than a directly transferable predictive representation. The Mastery-Dynamics Encoder learns correctness dynamics without question identifiers or text embeddings. Domain-Local Question Addressing builds fixed question addresses using a frozen text encoder and an unsupervised per-domain projection. The Text-Addressing Kernel uses these addresses to aggregate the current student's previous outcomes into a question-specific historical correctness summary. Cross-Segment Continuation

translated_title: 文本作为索引的零样本跨域知识追踪
translated_abstract: 知识追踪（KT）根据学生的历史作答记录预测其下一次作答表现。新平台通常只有题目文本而没有可供训练的作答日志，这推动了零样本跨域知识追踪的研究。现有的迁移和冷启动方法利用题目语义，但跨平台之间的语义差异限制了可迁移性。我们提出TIZSKT，该方法将行为序列建模与域内局部历史证据构建分离开来，并将文本用作索引而非直接可迁移的预测表示。掌握度动态编码器在不依赖题目标识符或文本嵌入的情况下学习正误动态。域内局部题目寻址利用冻结的文本编码器和无监督的域内投影构建固定的题目地址。文本寻址核利用这些地址将当前学生以往的作答结果聚合为针对特定题目的历史正误摘要。跨段续接……
tldr: 该论文提出TIZSKT框架，将文本作为索引而非直接可迁移的预测表示，通过分离行为序列建模与域内局部历史证据构建，实现了无需目标平台作答日志的零样本跨域知识追踪。
en_tdlr: TIZSKT uses text as an index rather than a directly transferable predictive representation, separating behavioral sequence modeling from domain-local historical evidence construction to enable zero-shot cross-domain knowledge tracing without response logs from target platforms.
